args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. A cute rolling CANDY WHEEL: a round red-and-white striped peppermint candy wheel with a cheeky mischievous face and small sugar crystal spikes around its rim. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size and all on the same invisible ground line, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. Side view facing left. Frames: (1)-(8) a smooth rolling rotation cycle, the wheel turned a little more each frame so the stripes spin, the face rotating with it. Each creature is about 15 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
